column1: # The pictures `just render` draws: name, build, view, scope, flags, tab-separated.
# view   iso, iso_back, front, back, right, left, top, bottom, or a rotation copied from the
#        GUI (Edit > Copy Viewport Rotation), for an angle found by eye.
# scope  assembly draws bioreactor.scad as it stands; head or frame draws one part of that half
#        on its own at the origin, as export-parts isolates it.
# flags  -D assignments, or any other OpenSCAD option. The cut is off unless a row turns it on:
#        -D cross_section_active=true, and cross_section_keep=0.75 for a quarter removed.
#        show_vessel, show_head and show_frame hide one part of the assembly; head.scad's
#        render_* flags pick a part within the head scope.
# Exploded views, labels and callouts are drawn by hand over these.
# the head: the lid and everything hanging from it
